graham.brief:
Houston has drifted off its opening spot this week. The spread has moved a point toward Houston. Houston is favored by 3 with a 48 total, which works out to about 25.5 points from them. That's a real move for Houston.

Dallas' run defense gives up ground, 5th-worst in the league at stopping the run.

Houston receivers have been getting open, and Dallas has been easy to throw on all year. C.J. Stroud is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Stroud's line is 32.5 pass attempts, below the 40 he's averaging. They've set David Montgomery at 11.5 rush attempts, below the 12.3 he's averaging.

The thing to count is how often Houston throws over the first two series, and fewer throws than usual means the plan broke.
